summary.text: One of the forty-four suitors from Zacynthus in Apollodorus' island catalogue — a masculine name closing the Zacynthian roll, not to be confused with Andromeda daughter of Cepheus.

story.text: Apollodorus ends the Zacynthian catalogue with 'Polybus and Andromedes' after Ormenus — the second Polybus entry in the same list is treated as a scribal duplicate of `polybus-zacynthus`, and Andromedes closes the forty-four.
